notes.title: Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place, AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We have a very exciting announcement:
We've just released a new horror game to celebrate the Spring Season!

[i]Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place[/i] is available now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2485750/Midnight_Scenes_A_Safe_Place/   

Phil's life has crumbled to dust. The four walls of his room have become his safe haven. He yearns for sleep...but terrible nightmares haunt him. Welcome to a new dimension of horror.
Welcome to [i]Midnight Scenes[/i].

[list]
[*] Enjoy this exciting and intense tale through the eyes of Phil, a young man tormented by horrible nightmares.
[*] A Horror Fiction Adventure that will take you to unsuspected limits.
[*] Explore, interact with your surroundings...and face your fears.
[*] Colorful pixel art inspired by horror and mystery classics like The Twilight Zone and The Outer Limits.
[*] Spooky and dark original soundtrack.
[*] Atmospheric sound effects.
[/list]

Will you find your safe place?

You can get it 10% off on launch week, so… what are you waiting for? ;)

Octavi & Susanna

notes.title: Midnight Scenes: From the Woods, AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!
We have a very exciting announcement:
We've just released a new horror game for a very bloody Valentine’s Day!

[i]Midnight Scenes: From the Woods[/i] is available now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197760/Midnight_Scenes_From_the_Woods/  

Disturbing incidents begin happening after the arrival of a new patient at Fernwood Creek Mental Health Center.
Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to [i]Midnight Scenes[/i].

[list]
[*] Enjoy this exciting and intense tale through the eyes of Elijah, a boy with anxiety disorder.
[*] Story-driven point-and-click horror experience that will chill you to the core.
[*] Explore, interact with your surroundings...and keep your eyes open.
[*] Colorful pixel art based on '90s aesthetics, inspired by horror and mystery classics like The Twilight Zone and The Outer Limits.
[*] Emotional original soundtrack.
[*] Atmospheric sound effects
[/list]

Welcome to Fernwood Creek. Do you dare to stay?

You can get it 10% off on launch week, so… what are you waiting for? ;)

Octavi & Susanna

notes.title: Uninvited 1.13 hotfix
notes.content:
1.13 hotfix:

[list]
[*] Fixed the "Survivor" achievement.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game registered the player as "running" while inside the closet.
[*] Player don't sweat anymore while an item is activated.
[/list]

notes.title: Uninvited 1.12 hotfix
notes.content:
1.12 hotfix:

- Decreased the ghost killing range.
- Fixed a bug where the code panel got frozen on screen when the player is killed.

notes.title: Uninvited 1.11 hotfix
notes.content:
Uninvited 1.11 patch notes:

- Fixed a bug that broke the game when crossing doors in some circumstances.

notes.title: Uninvited 1.1 Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

First of all, thank you for your support! We hope you're enjoying your time in the Morgan's House! :)

We have a small update for you:

[list]
[*] Added an Easy Mode, for those of you who are struggling too much with the game.
[*] Fixed a bug where some items got frozen on the screen.
[/list]

We'll keep releasing patches fixing bugs and improving the game in the upcoming days.

Thank you so much for your patience!

Octavi & Susanna
